name: manual_c9650f
claim: Keep generous free disk before OpenClaw plugin stages: a full disk made the codex plugin fail to load with no-space-left, the gateway restart slowly and warn about slow SQLite, and the seats lose their OAuth route; check free space first and free the agreed obsolete runtime.
conditions: disk space enospc plugin codex gateway

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26: the data volume was at 100 percent with 3 GiB free; after removing the obsolete node version the plugin loaded and both seats answered on Terra via the codex harness with their saved login profile.

rationale: 2026-11-26: the data volume was at 100 percent with 3 GiB free; after removing the obsolete node version the plugin loaded and both seats answered on Terra via the codex harness with their saved login profile.
